about: Pidilite Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the consumer and industrial specialty chemicals business in India and internationally. It operates through the Consumer & Bazaar, and Business to Business segments. The Consumer & Bazaar segment offers adhesives, sealants, art and craft materials; and construction and paint chemicals for carpenters, painters, plumbers, mechanics, households, students, and offices.
